input.sql:
SELECT t.team_long_name, SUM(m.away_team_goal) AS total_away_goals
FROM Match m JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY total_away_goals DESC
LIMIT 10;
